sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS)
downloadInstructions: Download the national annual OEWS employment estimates from the official BLS OEWS tables page.
Add one record per six-digit SOC occupation. Keep annual employment estimates only; do not substitute wages, projections, or neighboring occupations.
Record the official release/table URL, its publication date, and the date the file was retrieved.
Include only values verified against that BLS release. Omit suppressed or unavailable observations.
After replacing this template with verified records, set templateOnly to false.

recordSchema.socCode: Six-digit SOC code in NN-NNNN format, matching the occupation's O*NET code prefix.
recordSchema.occupationTitle: Exact occupation title used in the selected BLS OEWS release.
recordSchema.sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — OEWS.
recordSchema.sourceUrl: Direct official BLS release or table URL for this record.
recordSchema.publicationDate: Actual BLS publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
recordSchema.retrievedAt: Actual download/verification timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
recordSchema.recordStatus: Must be verified only after checking every value against the cited BLS source.

points.year: integer calendar year from the BLS annual table
points.employment: non-negative integer annual employment estimate from BLS
